[[Manton the Indulgent]] is a [[White Mantle]] [[boss]] that is part of the expedition seeking to gain access to the [[Henge of Denravi]] ahead of the [[Shining Blade]].

== Missions ==
* [[Maguuma Jungle]]
** {{NPC location|Aurora Glade}}

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Aura of Restoration}}
* {{skill icon|Glyph of Elemental Power}}
* {{skill icon|Searing Heat}}
* {{skill icon|Ward Against Elements}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Savant's Robes]]

== Notes ==
* Manton may randomly spawn in one of the points marked on the map. She shares them with [[Holt the Iron Boot Heel]], [[Cuthbert the Chaste]], [[Garr the Merciful]], [[Kenric the Believer]], and [[Lars the Obeisant]]. As such, there is a chance that Manton will not spawn at all.
* Searing Heat and Glyph of Elemental Power are skills that may be beneficial to [[Signet of Capture|capture]] from Manton in this mission, since the closest [[skill trainer]]s in the Prophecies storyline are in [[Copperhammer Mines]] and [[Port Sledge]] respectively. Both [[outpost]]s are still a long way off in the [[Southern Shiverpeaks]].
